headline: Asian Markets on Fire! Taiex Plunges 6%, Nikkei and Kospi Slump 4.5%
summary: Asian stock markets sold off sharply, with Taiwan's Taiex down about 6% and Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's Kospi each falling about 4.5%. Investor concerns about AI investment were cited as the trigger.
why: Taiwan's Taiex, Japan's Nikkei 225 and South Korea's Kospi are the main benchmark indexes for the region's technology-heavy markets, which are closely tied to global AI chip and hardware demand.

impacts.name: Taiex
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell about 6% in the sell-off.

impacts.name: Kospi
impacts.why: The index fell about 4.5% in the same regional sell-off.
